test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Transactions".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It means a piece of business that is done between people.
 
• Here, it means to make payments.
 
• **Example - ***The cashier asked the customer if she wanted a receipt for her transaction.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__* ***

 
• * ***Business **means buying and selling as a way of earning money. 

 
 
• **Example - ***They are planning to setup their own business.*
 
 
 
• **Contracts **mean a written legal agreement.
 
 
• **Example - ***They signed a two-year contract.*
 
 
 
• **Sites **mean places where work is going on.
 
 
• **Example - ***They are working on sites near bus stands.*
